text:
sarah: hey team — our integration started failing with 401 this morning right after I rotated keys. I copied the new key from the dashboard and updated our service, but we still get 401 invalid_api_key.

sarah: reproduce:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer PREVIEW_a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j\" \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
-> HTTP/1.1 401 {\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\"}

ash: hi @sarah — sorry about that. quick q: are you using Hosted API or Dedicated? and can you paste the exact token you copied (we can redact later)?

sarah: Hosted. pasted above — the string I copied starts with `PREVIEW_` (I thought that was normal). I tried regenerating and copying again but same result.

ash: holding while i check logs. @devon can you grep auth logs for the org and timestamp around 2026-03-17T09:12Z?

audit-bot: audit:preview_copy - user=sarah@acmecorp org=acmecorp action=copy_preview_key time=2026-03-17T09:12:34Z

devon: quick update — our auth logs show multiple requests presenting tokens prefixed with `PREVIEW_`. We intentionally never accept preview tokens at the API layer. Log sample: 
```
time=2026-03-17T09:12:36Z level=warn auth_type=preview_key result=rejected reason=preview_token_cannot_auth org=acmecorp src=52.11.22.33
```

devon: explanation: the dashboard shows a masked preview string for a new key row (helpful for copy/see layout). There was a UI affordance that let the preview be copied; if you copy that placeholder you get a PREVIEW_... string which is not a real secret. Real keys start with `rk_` and are only shown once on key creation.

sarah: ahhh — that makes sense. I must have hit the copy control on the preview row. Is that an intended behavior? it seems dangerous.

devon: not intended to be usable. UX team made that to demonstrate format but we agree it's confusing. I filed REQ-1234 to change the preview to not be copyable and add a stronger warning. Short-term: go to Console > API Keys > New key > Create key. Copy the value that begins with `rk_` right after creation (it won't be shown again). Update your env var to that value.

ash: @sarah if you want I can force-invalidate any preview tokens (they should be inert already). Let us know when you've updated so we can confirm traffic.

sarah: regenerated an `rk_` key, updated service, restarted. run the same curl again and now get 200 OK + embedding vector. :tada: Logs show requests accepted.

ash: awesome — closing this thread. devon, leaving REQ-1234 for UI change and a short dashboard banner note pushed to prod.

devon: noted. thanks for the quick confirm, @sarah — sorry for the confusion and we'll make the change to prevent future accidental copies.
